rootScripts.verify: turbo run typecheck lint test typecheck:root lint:root check:workspace format:check i18n:check

ci:
jobs:
  verify:
    needs: install
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - name: pnpm verify
        run: pnpm verify
      - name: Every cacheable verify task is now a cache hit
        run: pnpm check:turbo-cache


  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: audit
        run: pnpm audit:prod
